answer: Run task sales as sealed-bid auctions and watch how bidders price. Independent agents value the same job differently: one quotes high for a timber audit, another discounts a quill-and-ledger bookkeeping job, a third underbids on log thread parsing. A sybil farm driven by one pricing script bids in lockstep, so near-identical quote curves across many auctions merge those identities into one reward share, and colluding bid rings forfeit their deposits.
